[Source: Yogasutra.janvier. 2020.pdf, éd. 2021.pdf | Section: Yoga-Sūtra III.51 (Vibhūtipāda) | Pages 672-675]

ānaṃ devānāṃ priyam iti / Evam abhidhīyamānaḥ saṅga-doṣān bhāvayet-- ghoreṣu
saṃsāra-aṅgāreṣu pacyamānena mayā janana-maraṇa-andhakāre viparivartamānena kathaṃ
cid āsāditaḥ kleśa-timira-vināśī yoga-pradīpaḥ / Tasya ca–ete tṛṣṇā-yonayo viṣaya-vāyavaḥ
pratipakṣāḥ / Sa khalv ahaṃ labdha-ālokaḥ, katham anayā viṣaya-mṛga-tṛṣṇayā vañcitas
tasya–eva punaḥ pradīptasya saṃsāra-agner ātmānam indhanī kuryām iti / Svasti vaḥ
svapna-upamebhyaḥ kṛpaṇa-jana-prārthanīyebhyo viṣayebhya ity evaṃ niścita-matiḥ
samādhiṃ bhāvayet / Saṅgam akṛtvā smayam api na kuryāt-- evam ahaṃ devānām api
prārthanīya iti / Smayād aya�
